text.tspan: Every night at 3:17, one apartment in the city lights up violet.
Everyone who enters remembers a different version of the same life.
and characters who make terrible choices beautifully.

svg.text: Mina follows a violet reflection into an apartment that does not exist by day.
A silent tenant offers Mina a key—but only if she promises never to use it.
The building wakes in 1998. Mina is the only person who notices.
Mina returns to the first door and finds her own name written underneath.

text.tspan: After her sister vanishes, Mina moves into the last building she visited. Every night at 3:17,
one apartment glows violet and opens into a different year. The residents remember Mina—but
none of them remember the same version of her.
